extract_notes: skip: LCA+LCC study of apple production cooperatives vs smallholder farmers in Qingcheng County Gansu. No sampling-point level OP concentration data. Tables contain agricultural input rates (kg/ha), LCI modeled emissions (kg/t apples), and LCA impact potentials (CO2-eq/SO2-eq/PO4-eq/1,4-DCB-eq). Pesticides mentioned (mancozeb/carbendazim/chlorothalonil/chlorpyrifos/omethoate/atrazine) are application rates and modeled emissions, not measured soil concentrations. No PAH/PCB/DDT/HCH/PBDE/PHC/antibiotic/PAE/OCP data.
